2753.sigma:
title: LiteLLM Virtual Key Minted With Wildcard allowed_routes (CVE-2026-47101)
id: 6b3a4f1c-d2f5-4f0e-8e91-7c4a5a2c1d11
status: experimental
description: Detects POST requests to LiteLLM key/team management endpoints whose JSON body sets allowed_routes to a wildcard "/*", the authorization-bypass payload disclosed by Obsidian Security as the first link in the LiteLLM CVE-2026-47101 chain.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1078.003
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_method:
    cs-method: POST
  selection_url:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/key/generate'
      - '/key/update'
      - '/team/new'
      - '/team/update'
      - '/team/member_add'
  selection_body:
    cs-body|contains|all:
      - 'allowed_routes'
      - '/*'
  condition: selection_method and selection_url and selection_body
falsepositives:
  - LiteLLM proxy administrators legitimately creating super-keys for trusted automation
level: high
2753.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.http_method) as method values(Web.user) as user values(Web.dest) as dest from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.http_method="POST" (Web.url="*/key/generate*" OR Web.url="*/key/update*" OR Web.url="*/team/new*" OR Web.url="*/team/update*" OR Web.url="*/team/member_add*") by Web.src Web.url Web.http_user_agent | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | join type=left src [search index=* sourcetype=*waf* OR sourcetype=*nginx* OR sourcetype=*proxy* method=POST (uri_path="*/key/generate*" OR uri_path="*/key/update*") ("allowed_routes" AND ("/*" OR "\"/*\"")) | stats values(_raw) as raw_body by src] | where isnotnull(raw_body) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2753.datadog: (source:nginx OR source:apache OR source:python OR source:cloudflare) @http.method:POST (@http.url_details.path:(*/key/generate* OR */key/update* OR */team/new* OR */team/update*)) @http.request.body:(*allowed_routes* AND *\"/*\"*)
2753.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/applicationelb (ALB access logs in front of LiteLLM) or the app's own access log group
fields @timestamp, client_ip, request, target_status_code, user_agent, request_creation_time
| filter request like /POST .*\/(key\/generate|key\/update|team\/new|team\/update|team\/member_add)/

id: 4c1e8f2a-9d3b-4e7c-b6f1-2a8c9d4e5f63
status: experimental
description: Detects the LiteLLM Python proxy (uvicorn/gunicorn running litellm) spawning an OS shell, netcat, curl/wget, or another interpreter — the post-exploit footprint of the Custom Code Guardrail sandbox escape (CVE-2026-40217) and the stdio-MCP subprocess CVE (CVE-2026-42271, CISA KEV).
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/litellm-vulnerability-chain-lets-low.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
      - '/uvicorn'
      - '/gunicorn'
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - 'litellm'
  selection_child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/perl'
  selection_child_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'bash -i'
      - '/dev/tcp/'
      - 'os.system'
      - 'import pty'
      - 'socket.socket'
  condition: selection_parent and (selection_child_image or selection_child_cmd)
falsepositives:
  - LiteLLM custom guardrails legitimately shelling out to a vetted helper script (rare; should be vetted)
  - Container init scripts wrapping litellm with curl-based health checks
level: high

description: Detects writes to LiteLLM's config.yaml (where litellm_settings.callbacks lives) by processes other than common editors. Callbacks fire on every request and never surface in the admin UI — explicit hiding spot for post-RCE attackers per the Obsidian disclosure.

  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/litellm/'
      - '/etc/litellm/'
      - '/opt/litellm/'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - 'config.yaml'
      - 'litellm_config.yaml'
      - 'proxy_config.yaml'
  filter_editor:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/vim'
      - '/nano'
      - '/vi'
      - '/emacs'
      - '/code'
      - '/nvim'

2795.sigma:
title: Unauthorized Modification of Linux PAM Authentication Module
id: 7b3b4f4e-2d6e-4a51-9f6c-6a3e8d12c8aa
status: experimental
description: Detects write or replacement of pam_*.so authentication modules by any process other than the host package manager. Maps to Sygnia Velvet Ant Operation Highland — the actor swapped pam_unix.so on Linux hosts to backdoor the login path.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/china-linked-hackers-backdoored-linux.html
  - https://www.sygnia.co/blog/operation-highland-velvet-ant/
author: thn-usecases
date: 2026/06/13
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1556.003
  - attack.t1554
logsource:
  product: linux
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/lib/security/pam_'
      - '/lib64/security/pam_'
      - '/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'
      - '/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'
      - '/usr/lib64/security/pam_'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.so'
  filter_pkgmgr:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/dpkg'
      - '/dpkg-deb'
      - '/apt'
      - '/apt-get'
      - '/aptitude'
      - '/unattended-upgrade'
      - '/yum'
      - '/dnf'
      - '/rpm'
      - '/zypper'
      - '/pacman'
      - '/ldconfig'
      - '/snapd'
  condition: selection_path and not filter_pkgmgr
falsepositives:
  - Manual package reinstall or recompile by sysadmin
  - Custom in-house PAM module deployment via configuration management
level: high

let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let FailureThreshold = 20;
union isfuzzy=true
  (W3CIISLog
   | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
   | where csUriStem startswith "/api/v1/"
   | where scStatus in (401, 403)
   | project TimeGenerated, SrcIp = cIP, Host = sSiteName, Uri = csUriStem,
             Status = scStatus, UA = csUserAgent, Method = csMethod),
  (AppServiceHTTPLogs
   | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
   | where CsUriStem startswith "/api/v1/"
   | where ScStatus in (401, 403)
   | project TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp, Host = CsHost, Uri = CsUriStem,
             Status = ScStatus, UA = UserAgent, Method = CsMethod),
  (CommonSecurityLog
   | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
   | where RequestURL has "/api/v1/"
   | where EventOutcome in ("401", "403")
   | project TimeGenerated, SrcIp = SourceIP, Host = DestinationHostName,
             Uri = RequestURL, Status = toint(EventOutcome),
             UA = RequestClientApplication, Method = RequestMethod)
| summarize FailedAttempts = count(),
            UniquePaths = dcount(Uri),
            SamplePaths = make_set(Uri, 8),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),

            by SrcIp, Host, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)

| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| stats sum(count) as Failures dc(url) as UniquePaths values(url) as Paths min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by src dest

2871.sent:
let LookbackHours = 2h;
let LoginWindowSec = 1800;
let AdminHits =
  union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
     | where csUriStem startswith "/api/v1/admin/" or csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/token/refresh"
     | where scStatus == 200
     | project AdminTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = cIP, AdminUri = csUriStem,
               UA = csUserAgent, Host = sSiteName),
    (AppServiceHTTPLogs
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
     | where CsUriStem startswith "/api/v1/admin/" or CsUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/token/refresh"
     | where ScStatus == 200
     | project AdminTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp, AdminUri = CsUriStem,
               UA = UserAgent, Host = CsHost);
let LoginEvents =
  union isfuzzy=true
    (W3CIISLog
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours + 1h)
     | where csUriStem in ("/api/v1/login", "/api/v1/auth/login", "/login", "/oauth/token")
     | where scStatus == 200
     | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = cIP),
    (AppServiceHTTPLogs
     | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours + 1h)
     | where CsUriStem in ("/api/v1/login", "/api/v1/auth/login", "/login", "/oauth/token")
     | where ScStatus == 200
     | project LoginTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIp = CIp);
AdminHits
| join kind=leftouter LoginEvents on SrcIp
| extend HasRecentLogin = isnotempty(LoginTime)
         and datetime_diff('second', AdminTime, LoginTime) between (0 .. LoginWindowSec)
| summarize HasRecentLogin = max(HasRecentLogin),
            AdminHits = dcount(AdminTime),
            Endpoints = make_set(AdminUri, 10),
            UAs = make_set(UA, 5),
            FirstHit = min(AdminTime),
            LastHit = max(AdminTime)
          by SrcIp, Host
| where HasRecentLogin == false
| order by LastHit desc
2871.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.status=200 AND (Web.url="*/api/v1/admin/*" OR Web.url="*/api/v1/token/refresh*") by Web.src Web.url _time
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rename _time as admin_time
| join type=left src [
    | tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.status=200 AND (Web.url="*/api/v1/login*" OR Web.url="*/api/v1/auth/login*" OR Web.url="*/login*" OR Web.url="*/oauth/token*") by Web.src _time
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
    | stats max(_time) as last_login by src ]
| where isnull(last_login) OR (admin_time - last_login) > 1800
| eval login_gap_min = round((admin_time - coalesce(last_login,0))/60, 1)
| table admin_time src url login_gap_min last_login
| sort - admin_time

id: 4f8e6c20-9a1d-4b2e-bb73-d4e7a3b08c91
description: Detects the IIS worker process spawning interactive shells or recon LOLBins, consistent with post-exploitation of the June 2026 HTTP.sys integer-overflow RCE (CVE-2026-47291) or other webshell activity.
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/microsoft-patch-tuesday-for-june-2026-snort-rules-and-prominent-vulnerabilities/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\nltest.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
  condition: selection
level: high
2898.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
  from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
  where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe"
    AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","arp.exe","wmic.exe","hostname.exe","quser.exe")
  by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| sort - lastTime
2898.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\CertUtil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\wmic.exe)
2898.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/w3wp\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|whoami|net|net1|nltest|systeminfo|tasklist|ipconfig|wmic|hostname|quser)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

let HypervProcs = dynamic(["vmwp.exe","vmms.exe","vmcompute.exe","vmsp.exe"]);
let AllowedChildren = dynamic(["vmwp.exe","vmms.exe","vmcompute.exe","vmsp.exe","WerFault.exe","conhost.exe","wermgr.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (HypervProcs)
| where FileName !in~ (AllowedChildren)
| extend SuspChild = FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","schtasks.exe","wmic.exe")
| extend SuspPath = FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\",@"\AppData\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Windows\Temp\",@"\Windows\Tasks\")
| where SuspChild or SuspPath
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountSid,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
2899.sent:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("vmwp.exe","vmms.exe","vmcompute.exe","vmsp.exe")
| extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildName !in ("vmwp.exe","vmms.exe","vmcompute.exe","vmsp.exe","werfault.exe","conhost.exe","wermgr.exe")
| where ChildName in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","nltest.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","schtasks.exe","wmic.exe")
   or NewProcessName has_any (@"\Users\Public\",@"\AppData\",@"\ProgramData\",@"\Windows\Temp\")

| order by TimeGenerated desc

2900.def:
let CrashWindow = 2h;
let Crashes = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType in ("UnexpectedShutdown","OsBugCheck","KernelCrash")
    | project CrashTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, CrashDetails = AdditionalFields;
Crashes
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted" or ActionType == "ConnectionAccepted"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | summarize InboundCount = count(), UniqueSrcIPs = dcount(RemoteIP), SampleRemotes = make_set(RemoteIP, 10), TargetPorts = make_set(LocalPort, 10)
              by DeviceId, NetWindowEnd = bin(Timestamp, CrashWindow)
    | where InboundCount > 500 or UniqueSrcIPs > 25
) on DeviceId
| where CrashTime between (NetWindowEnd - CrashWindow .. NetWindowEnd + CrashWindow)
| project CrashTime, DeviceName, InboundCount, UniqueSrcIPs, SampleRemotes, TargetPorts, CrashDetails
| order by CrashTime desc
2900.sent:
let CrashWindow = 2h;
let Crashes = Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Source in ("Microsoft-Windows-WER-SystemErrorReporting","Save Dump","BugCheck","EventLog")
    | where EventID in (1001, 41, 6008, 1003)
    | project CrashTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, RenderedDescription;
Crashes
| join kind=inner (
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where CommunicationDirection == "Inbound"
    | summarize InboundCount = count(), UniqueSrcIPs = dcount(SourceIP), SampleRemotes = make_set(SourceIP, 10)
              by DestinationHostName, NetWindowEnd = bin(TimeGenerated, CrashWindow)
    | where InboundCount > 500 or UniqueSrcIPs > 25
) on $left.Computer == $right.DestinationHostName
| where CrashTime between (NetWindowEnd - CrashWindow .. NetWindowEnd + CrashWindow)
| project CrashTime, Computer, EventID, RenderedDescription, InboundCount, UniqueSrcIPs, SampleRemotes
| order by CrashTime desc
2900.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count as crash_count min(_time) as crash_time max(_time) as last_crash_time from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where source="WinEventLog:System" (EventCode=1001 OR EventCode=41 OR EventCode=6008) by host
| join type=inner host
  [| tstats `summariesonly` count as inbound_count dc(All_Traffic.src_ip) as distinct_src from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,135,139,445,3389,5985) AND All_Traffic.direction="inbound" earliest=-1h by All_Traffic.dest as host
    | rename All_Traffic.dest as host]
| where inbound_count > 1000 OR distinct_src > 50
| sort - crash_time

2901.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Pythagora-io/gpt-pilot Compromised on GitHub - Shai-Hulud Credential Stealer Blo
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("__init__.py", "_index.js", "node.js", "kernel32.dll", "updater.py", "ai_setup.sh", "gh-token-monitor.sh", "token-monitor.sh"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/.bun_ran", "/tmp/.sshu-", "/dev/stdin", "/usr/bin/env", "/dev/null", "/tmp/tmp.0144018410.lock", "/var/tmp/.gh_update_state", "/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.update-monitor.plist") or FileName in~ ("__init__.py", "_index.js", "node.js", "kernel32.dll", "updater.py", "ai_setup.sh", "gh-token-monitor.sh", "token-monitor.sh"))

      - '/python3'

id: 7d8e9a1f-3c4b-4e5d-9a6b-2c1d3e4f5a6b
status: experimental
description: Detects Stata executables spawning command shells, indicating likely exploitation of CVE-2026-47708 in stata-mcp where the log_file_name parameter is interpolated unsanitised into a Stata command, permitting Stata `shell` command injection.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p62-hqp5-g644
  - https://github.com/SepineTam/stata-mcp/commit/e6f945941ae0c7cf5e74a428e0b3dc82b396382f
author: detection-pipeline
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\stata.exe'
      - '\stata-mp.exe'
      - '\stata-se.exe'
      - '\stata-be.exe'
      - '\xstata.exe'
      - '\xstata-mp.exe'
      - '\xstata-se.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Researcher-authored do-files that intentionally call Stata's `shell` command
  - Legitimate stata-mcp `python` integration that spawns python.exe
level: high
2951.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","stata","stata-mp","stata-se","stata-be")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","zsh","bash","sh","python.exe","python","python3")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2951.datadog: (source:windows.sysmon OR source:windows.security) @ParentImage:(*\\stata.exe OR *\\STATA.exe OR *\\Stata.exe OR *\\stata-mp.exe OR *\\StataMP.exe OR *\\stata-se.exe OR *\\stata-be.exe OR *\\xstata.exe OR *\\xstata-mp.exe OR *\\xstata-se.exe) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\bash.exe OR *\\sh.exe OR *\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe)
2951.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(stata|stata-mp|stata-se|stata-be|xstata|xstata-mp|xstata-se)(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|bash|sh|zsh|python3?)\.exe$/i or ImageFileName=/\/(bash|sh|zsh|python3?)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2952.def:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","python.exe","python","python3")
| where FileName endswith ".log"
| where FileName matches regex @"[;|&`'\"]|\.\."
     or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("stata_mcp","stata-mcp","log_file_name")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, FolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
2952.sent:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated" or EventType == "FileModified"
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","python.exe","python","python3")
| where TargetFileName endswith ".log"
| where TargetFileName matches regex @"[;|&`'\"]|\.\."
     or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("stata_mcp","stata-mcp","log_file_name")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2952.sigma:
title: Stata-Written Log File With Shell Metacharacters or Path Traversal (CVE-2026-47708)
id: 9b1c2d3e-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects .log files written by Stata or the stata-mcp Python wrapper whose filename contains shell metacharacters (semicolon, pipe, backtick, quote) or path traversal sequences, the deterministic artefact of CVE-2026-47708 exploitation against unpatched stata-mcp installations (<1.17.3).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p62-hqp5-g644
  - https://github.com/SepineTam/stata-mcp/commit/e6f945941ae0c7cf5e74a428e0b3dc82b396382f
author: detection-pipeline
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\stata.exe'
      - '\stata-mp.exe'
      - '\stata-se.exe'
      - '\stata-be.exe'
      - '\xstata.exe'
      - '\xstata-mp.exe'
      - '\xstata-se.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.log'
  selection_payload:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - ';'
      - '|'
      - '`'
      - "'"
      - '"'
      - '..'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_ext and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - Researchers using single-quote characters in legitimate Stata log filenames (rare)
level: high
2952.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.process_name IN ("stata.exe","stata-mp.exe","stata-se.exe","stata-be.exe","xstata.exe","xstata-mp.exe","xstata-se.exe","stata","stata-mp","stata-se","stata-be","python.exe","python","python3")) AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.log") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where match(file_name,"[;|&`'\"]|\\.\\.") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2952.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\stata.exe OR *\\STATA.exe OR *\\stata-mp.exe OR *\\stata-se.exe OR *\\stata-be.exe OR *\\xstata.exe OR *\\python.exe) @TargetFilename:(*.log) @TargetFilename:(*\;* OR *\|* OR *\&* OR *..* OR *\`* OR *\'* OR *\"*)
2952.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| ContextImageFileName=/(stata|stata-mp|stata-se|stata-be|xstata|xstata-mp|xstata-se|python3?)(\.exe)?$/i
| TargetFileName=/\.log$/i
| regex("[;|&`'\"]|\\.\\.", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

2953.def:

let exfilHost = "t.m-kosche.com";
let exfilPath = "/api/public/otel/v1/traces";
union isfuzzy=true
(DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where RemoteUrl has exfilHost or RemoteUrl has exfilPath
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
            InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
            InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,
            Source="DeviceNetworkEvents"),
(DeviceEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where ActionType in ("DnsQueryResponse","ConnectionSuccess","NetworkConnectionEvents")
  | where RemoteUrl has exfilHost or AdditionalFields has exfilHost
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
            InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
            InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,
            Source="DeviceEvents")
| order by Timestamp desc
2953.sent:
// Mini Shai-Hulud TeamPCP exfil endpoint - DNS + web egress
let exfilHost = "t.m-kosche.com";
let exfilPath = "/api/public/otel/v1/traces";
union isfuzzy=true
(DnsEvents
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where Name has exfilHost

  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where DnsQuery has exfilHost
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, ClientIP=SrcIpAddr, Name=DnsQuery, QueryType=DnsQueryTypeName, Source="ImDnsActivity"),

  | where DestinationHostName has exfilHost or RequestURL has exfilPath or RequestURL has exfilHost
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=SourceHostName, ClientIP=SourceIP, Name=DestinationHostName, QueryType=RequestURL, Source="CommonSecurityLog"),
(ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where Url has exfilHost or Url has exfilPath
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, ClientIP=SrcIpAddr, Name=DstHostname, QueryType=Url, Source="ImWebSession")
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2954.def:
// TeamPCP Mini Shai-Hulud: Bun spawned from npm preinstall
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "bun.exe" or FileName =~ "bun"
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("npm.exe","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe","npm-cli.js","node","npm","yarn","pnpm","npx"))
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("preinstall","setup.mjs","execution.js")
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","execution.js")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
2954.sent:
// TeamPCP Mini Shai-Hulud: Bun spawned from npm preinstall (Sentinel — SecurityEvent 4688 + ASIM)
union isfuzzy=true
(SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bun.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "/bun"
  | where (ParentProcessName has_any ("\\npm.exe","\\node.exe","\\yarn.exe","\\pnpm.exe","\\npx.exe","/npm","/node","/yarn","/pnpm","/npx"))
       or CommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","execution.js","preinstall")
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Source="SecurityEvent"),
(ImProcessCreate
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where TargetProcessName endswith "bun.exe" or TargetProcessName endswith "/bun"
  | where (ParentProcessName has_any ("npm.exe","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"))
       or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("setup.mjs","execution.js")
       or ParentProcessCommandLine has "preinstall"
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, Account=ActorUsername, NewProcessName=TargetProcessName, CommandLine=TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, Source="ImProcessCreate")
| order by TimeGenerated desc

),

id: 71a3b8f2-7d18-4a8b-a6c3-3b1f9b4b2a5c
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious child processes (shells, recon binaries) or Kubernetes service-account token reads from the python process running Jupyter Enterprise Gateway, indicative of SSTI RCE post-exploitation (CVE-2026-44181, GHSA-f49j-v924-fx9w).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f49j-v924-fx9w
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1552.005
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  parent_python:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/python3.10'
      - '/python3.11'
      - '/python3.12'
  suspicious_child_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/ash'
      - '/hostname'
      - '/id'
      - '/whoami'
      - '/uname'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/kubectl'
  token_read:
    CommandLine|contains: '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount'
  condition: parent_python and (suspicious_child_shell or token_read)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Jupyter kernel-launcher subprocess.Popen invocations to start a Python kernel (those launch python child, not sh/bash/curl)

level: high

2993.def:
let bunUrlIndicators = dynamic(["github.com/oven-sh/bun", "oven-sh/bun/releases", "bun-windows-x64", "bun-linux-x64", "bun-darwin"]);
let npmParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"]);
let downloaderChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
// Process-tree pivot — npm parent spawning a downloader child with Bun URL on the command line
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents)
    | where FileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
// Network pivot — same process families connecting to github.com for the Bun release tarball

2999.def:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in ("FileOpened","FileAccessed","FileCreated")
| where FolderPath startswith "/proc/" and FileName == "mem"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","bun")
| extend TargetPid = extract(@"/proc/(\d+)/", 1, FolderPath)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName has_any ("Runner.Worker","Runner.Listener")
    | project DeviceId, TargetPid = tostring(ProcessId), RunnerCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RunnerName = FileName
) on DeviceId, TargetPid
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, TargetPid, RunnerName, RunnerCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
2999.sent:
let ProcMemRe = @"/proc/\d+/mem";
let RunnerHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where SyslogMessage matches regex ProcMemRe
    | where SyslogMessage has_any ("node", "bun")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostName, Facility, ProcessName, SyslogMessage;
let AsimHits = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where TargetFilePath matches regex ProcMemRe
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("node", "bun")
    | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFilePath;
union isfuzzy=true RunnerHits, AsimHits
| order by TimeGenerated desc
2999.sigma:
title: Node or Bun reads /proc/<pid>/mem (Runner.Worker secret scrape)
id: 7c1b9d2e-3a4c-4f60-9e1b-4a7c8f604f8a
description: Detects the redhat-cloud-services implant reading /proc/<pid>/mem from a node or bun process to scrape in-memory secrets held by GitHub Actions Runner.Worker.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/multiple-redhat-cloud-services-npm-packages-compromised
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/01
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.007
  - attack.t1552.001
logsource:
  category: file_access
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/bun'
    TargetFilename|re: '^/proc/[0-9]+/mem$'
  condition: selection
level: critical
2999.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc values(Filesystem.process_path) as proc_path values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="read" Filesystem.file_path="/proc/*/mem" Filesystem.process_name IN ("node","bun") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rex field=file_path "/proc/(?<target_pid>\d+)/mem" | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
2999.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:(SYSCALL OR PATH) @file.path:/proc/*/mem @process.name:(node OR bun OR Node OR Bun) -@process.executable.path:(/usr/bin/gdb OR /usr/bin/strace OR /usr/lib/systemd/*)
2999.falcon:
#event_simpleName=/^(FileOpenInfo|FileWritten)$/
| TargetFileName=/^\/proc\/[0-9]+\/mem$/
| ContextImageFileName=/\/(node|bun)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())
